name: MOT_TERR_RULES_
description:
This is the entity that organizes the territory boundaries ie. dimensions in the form of Rules. Using this territories can be either just simple territories defined by a single rule or complex ones with multiple rules. This entity along with Territory Rule Boundary Value stores the dimensions of the Territory in an expression form. 
Rules are evaluated as choices ie. not additively. eg. if Rule 1 has Geography and Product as dimensions and Rule 2 has only Geography and Industry as dimensions, both will be evaluated and the Territory will be chosen if either Rule is a match.

columns.name: RULE_NUMBER
columns.description: A unique number within a territory definition. Generated from a sequence.

columns.name: RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifier for the type of rule, also known as coverage type.

columns.name: RULE_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Identifies whether the rule is inclusion or exclusion

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
